introHtml: Poly propylene pencils offer a unique twist on traditional wood pencils. Made from a flexible, unbreakable plastic, they are ideal for outdoor events, trade shows, or safety environments where wood splinters or breakage is a concern. These pencils can be imprinted with your logo using pad printing or hot stamping for a crisp, long-lasting mark. Choose custom poly propylene pencils for a durable giveaway that stands up to heavy use.
heroAltText: Custom poly propylene pencils with printed logos, featuring flexible plastic bodies and colored barrels.
